opai.title: OPAI
opai.subtitle: ERP with AI for Gard Security
opai.description: A comprehensive enterprise resource planning platform with integrated artificial intelligence, designed to manage operations, contracts, human resources, and finances for a national security company.
opai.challenge: Gard operated across disconnected spreadsheets, manual processes, and fragmented systems. Critical operational data was scattered, reporting took days, and scaling the business meant scaling the chaos.
opai.solution: We built OPAI, a custom ERP with AI capabilities that centralizes all operations into a single platform. Intelligent automation handles document processing, contract management, and operational reporting. The system integrates with existing tools and provides real-time visibility across the entire organization.
opai.results: 40% improvement in operational efficiency. 70% reduction in manual data processing. Full operational visibility in real time. The platform now supports company-wide decision-making with data-driven insights.

gard.title: gard.cl
gard.subtitle: Corporate website for Gard Security
gard.description: A modern, high-performance corporate website designed to position Gard as a leading security company in Chile.
gard.challenge: Gard needed a digital presence that reflected the professionalism and scale of their operations. Their previous site was outdated, slow, and failed to communicate their value proposition effectively.
gard.solution: We designed and built a fast, SEO-optimized website with a clear information architecture, strong visual identity, and conversion-focused layout. Built with Next.js for performance and deployed on modern infrastructure.
gard.results: Significant improvement in page load speed, search engine visibility, and lead generation. The site now serves as a credible digital front door for one of Chile's growing security firms.

aboutPage.title: About
aboutPage.headline: A software studio built to ship
aboutPage.thesis1: LX3 exists because growing businesses deserve the same quality of software that large enterprises take for granted. We are a Chilean studio that combines engineering rigor with practical business understanding to build systems that actually make it to production.
aboutPage.thesis2: We are not a body shop and we are not a consultancy. We are builders. Every project we take on gets a dedicated team, a clear process, and a commitment to delivering working software -- not slide decks.
aboutPage.p1Desc: The deliverable is a system in production, not a document. If it is not running, it is not done.
aboutPage.p2Desc: We tell you what is hard, what is risky, and what we do not know. We would rather lose a deal than overpromise.
aboutPage.p3Desc: Everything we build belongs to you. Source code, infrastructure, documentation. No lock-in, no recurring licenses on your own software.
